epics.title: Advent of Code 2020
epics.goal: Every 2020 puzzle solved efficiently in Stitchwort, with a spec and proofs that the program answers the puzzle, and friction notes that show where the language falls short. How the track runs (D2305, 4 Nov 2026): one day per lane, in order, on Opus, from Matt's ~/repos/mdr/aoc (github mdr/aoc) inputs, with his Scala solutions to cross-check answers; each day has a naive spec, an efficient solution, a proof they agree where natural, its input as a test, and friction notes in aoc/NOTES-2020.md.
